preamble:
The default build links OpenSSL and nghttp2 from the system. The portable build
(-DZETTA_TUNNEL_PORTABLE=ON) and the container image (Dockerfile, FROM scratch after an Alpine
build stage) link them statically, together with musl libc and LLVM's libc++, libc++abi,
libunwind and compiler-rt, so those are listed too. The versions of system and Alpine packages are
the ones installed where the binary is built; the license texts below are taken at the version
named.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.use: linked; statically in the portable build and the image

components.name: nghttp2
components.use: linked; statically in the portable build and the image

components.name: musl libc
components.use: linked statically in the image only

components.name: LLVM libc++, libc++abi, libunwind, compiler-rt
components.use: linked statically in the image only
